Spotify after the soft guide

SPOT · EUR · series 2026-09-13T15:32:00Z · built 2026-09-14 23:00 UTC

The short version

Q3 is guided below the trailing run-rate. That is not a miss they buried in a footnote. It is a soft patch they put on the calendar.

Premium printed ahead of guide. Gross margin beat. MAU came in a million light. The long case on Spotify does not hinge on whether one quarter’s MAU adds match the prior run-rate. It hinges on whether MAU and engagement actually roll over while management optimizes the ad tier — Latent’s primary falsifier, stress-tested on purpose.

What the print actually said

Second-quarter 2026 was a clean print with one soft edge.

MAU 777 million (+16M QoQ, +11.64% YoY). Premium 300 million (+7M, +8.70% YoY). Ad-supported MAU 494 million (+11M, +14.09% YoY). Overlapping cohorts, not additive.

Revenue €4,777 million (+14% / +15% FXN). Premium ARPU €4.89. GM 33.4%. OI €655 million vs €630 million guide. FCF €797 million; TTM FCF €3.3 billion (deck).

Vs guide: MAU adds 1M light; Premium 1M ahead; GM ~+30 bps.

Growth shape — a band, not a break

MAU YoY ~11–12% for eight quarters. Premium YoY ~12% H1’25 → ~9% H1’26.

Premium revenue ~16% FXN from ~9% subs + ~7.4% ARPU FXN.

Ad MAU still outgrowing Premium.

The turn — guide under run-rate, on purpose

Run-rate: MAU 793 / Prem 307. Guide: MAU 788 / Prem 305 / Rev €5.0B / GM 32.9% / OI €670M. Never blend.

Co-CEO: intentional EM ad-load / product optimization will show in Q3 MAU; not at expense of subscriber growth.

Margins managed — horizon, not proof

Q3 GM 32.9% guided (reinvestment + seasonal fee). ~€200M incremental FY26 opex.

FY GM/OM “expected to improve” — no FY numeric. Investor Day 2030 is wallpaper only (mid-teens CAGR, GM 35–40%, OM >20%).

What we cannot see

Conversion undisclosed. Premium/MAU ~38.6% is a stock proxy, not conversion. Churn discontinued.

Geo annual only (RoW 12%→37%). Podcast/audiobook hours+share null.

pe_ttm (ttm_4q) ≈ 32.89 @ $525.76 asof close (TTM NI €3,339M) — street-ish, finally computable after the interim NI fill. Sparse prints only: 37.47 @ 2026-03-31, 106.20 @ 2025-09-30. pe_fy (FY-end PE) FY2024 ≈ 81.33 @ $447.14, FY2025 ≈ 55.28 @ $580.92 — pe_fy ≠ pe_ttm. USD close over EUR earnings, not FX-adj.

Diluted WAS 208,858,469 at 2026-06-30 — footnote.

Refuse: invented conversion; additive MAU; blended guide/run-rate; format hours; FY margin number they didn’t give; interpolated pe_ttm or FX-adjusted PE; 2030 as near-term proof.

Method & definitional notes
  • Premium MAU + Ad-Supported MAU are overlapping period cohorts — not additive to total MAU.
  • pe_ttm (earnings_window=ttm_4q) is sparse desk prints only — latest ≈32.89 @ $525.76 asof close 2026-09-11 — and is never interpolated. pe_fy (earnings_window=fy) is FY-end prints only (FY2024 ≈ 81.33, FY2025 ≈ 55.28); pe_ttm is null on FY rows. USD price over EUR earnings — not FX-adjusted.
  • IR decks/remarks are narrative and guide only (kpi_extract=false). Guide is not written into historical SoT.
  • Q4 residuals already present in series.json are respected; the builder does not synthesize residuals from annual minus YTD.
  • premium_over_mau_pct is a stock proxy — not a conversion rate.
  • ad_arpu_monthly_equiv_eur is mechanical (ad_rev/(ad_mau*1e6))/3 — not a filing ARPU.
  • Premium+Ad MAU overlapping cohorts — NOT additive to total MAU
  • Q4 residuals: ARPU=4×FY avg−Q1−Q3; OI=FY−Q1−Q3; Premium/Ad rev=FY−Q1−Q3; OM=OI/rev
  • FY2021/FY2023 Premium from analytics/pack fixed 8460m / 11566m
  • pe_fy (FY-end PE, earnings_window=fy) 2 FY prints (FY2024≈81.33@$447.14, FY2025≈55.28@$580.92); pe_ttm (ttm_4q) sparse after interim NI fix — latest ≈32.89 @ $525.76 asof close 2026-09-11; USD/EUR not FX-adjusted; pe_fy ≠ pe_ttm
  • Diluted shares 34 periods; latest 208858469 at 2026-06-30
  • kpi_extract false on IR decks — narrative/guide only
  • 68 period parse-warnings in the file (16 Q4/residual-related). Residuals already on series.json are respected; this builder does not recompute them. Examples: q4_users_from_20f_ye; financials_may_be_residualized; q4_revenue_residual_fy_minus_q1q2q3; q4_cost_of_revenue_eur_residual_fy_minus_q1q2q3; q4_gross_profit_eur_residual_fy_minus_q1q2q3.
  • Non-additive: Premium MAU and Ad-Supported MAU are overlapping bases; they are not additive to MAU.
